summary: Metrus Energy, Inc. is the existing active U.S. Energy-as-a-Service platform acquired by ECP in July 2022. ECP and Energy Capital Partners are one manager identity, so the census does not justify another owner period. The record should add the official website, use San Francisco headquarters, remove the unsupported Canada tag and update disclosed 2025 scale, while leaving the acquisition fund, vehicle, seller, stake, co-investors and exact close date undisclosed. Project LLCs and financing, installation and customer counterparties remain subordinate or non-owner entities.
